column1: # The published CJK fallback faces' tables (docs/design/fallback-faces.md,
# "The storage form"): what crates/tinker-pdf/tests/cjk_faces.rs holds every
# table each stored WOFF2 file unpacks to against. cjk_face_tables, beside
# it, prints these rows from the published faces, release 2.005R of Source
#   TINKER_CJK_FACES=<directory> cargo test -p tinker-pdf --features cjk-fonts --test cjk_faces -- --ignored cjk_face_tables --exact --nocapture
# and the_record_is_the_published_faces holds them to the files wherever the
# variable names a directory holding them, each file first held to the
#   face   a row for each published face: its sfnt version, how many tables
#          its directory lists, and head's checkSumAdjustment and flags, the
#          two fields WOFF2 section 5 has a decoder and an encoder rewrite
#   table  a row for each of its tables, in its directory's order: the tag,
#          its four characters with a trailing space kept, the length its
#          directory states and the SHA-256 of those bytes
